acquisition: Read original provider-produced JSONs; verified against their package manifests. Only selected original fields retained. No neural forward or weights loaded.

AV.pair_success: both prescribed answers correct; same family, not400 independent observations
AV.dev_selection: maximize paired accuracy, then mean remove-image/remove-audio accuracy; earlier checkpoint, then prescribed job order
AV.seed_unit: three downstream training seeds; no claim of three independent pretrained LMs
AV.confidence_interval: Wilson on family successes, with each panel also reported
AV.comparison: paired family bootstrap1000 replicates, seed20261029; report each seed separately and seed mean, without treating 3x200 families as independent600

sound.snr_mean: per complete non-silent program, reference active event intervals, no realignment or gain fitting
sound.chain_pair_index: data definition predeclares alternating0/1; denominator retains A errors/refusals and every downstream failure
sound.chunk_equivalence: bit-exact individual decoder blocks versus whole-code decode; perturb future codes, emitted prefix unchanged
sound.first_chunk_timing: actual playable chunk arrival including complete autoregressive code generation; not a claim of interleaved code/text streaming

C.temperature_selection: equal-family, equal-three-types NLL; ties closest to1 then smallerT
C.policy_selection: maximum coverage with positive accepts and empirical accepted error<=0.05, ties higher threshold; no feasible policy means all handoff
C.accepted_rule: calibrated p_max>=tau AND chosen ID != none AND same-entity choice_info prediction=yes
C.accepted_error: choice wrong OR world unsupported OR gold required information insufficient
C.scope: single project-authored rule-world generator; held-out state wording template is not independent corpus/pretraining-unseen evidence

retention.excess_drop_behavior: retain historical default; keep new candidate weights available as research
retention.tool_reply: actual model call -> real calculator -> model answer; altered-tool prefixes reported separately as counterfactual diagnostics

legacy_scores.legacy_scope: Finite fixed grammar; C includes disclosed identical generic observations across family splits. Heldout-family scores are not open-domain natural-language generalization. More loops may worsen accuracy/CE. Latency is CPU/device-specific; concentration is not probability of correctness.

C_failure_examples.question: choice

limitations: Projection supports pure count/threshold replay of preserved measurements; it does not regenerate neural outputs or float32 waveform samples.
Legacy summaries are directly inspected fixed records; only listed numeric counts are recalculated, not a new full legacy final test.
All family denominators remain separate. Different tasks or diagnostic views must not be summed as independent samples.
